test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

One who hates war, loves peace
solution: The correct answer is: **Pacifist**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Pacifist **is a person who opposes war and violence. (एक व्यक्ति जो युद्ध और हिंसा का विरोध करता है) • The word is derived from the Latin word '**pax**', which means peace. • In the given sentence, the word **'one who hates war, loves peace'** is a synonym for **pacifist**. • Other synonyms for pacifist include peacemaker, dove, and antimilitarist. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us look at the meaning of the other words. • **Desecrater **means a person who violates or treats something sacred with disrespect. (वह व्यक्ति जो किसी पवित्र चीज़ का उल्लंघन करता है या अनादर के साथ व्यवहार करता है) • **Fatalist **means a person who believes that everything is predetermined and inevitable. (एक व्यक्ति जो मानता है कि सब कुछ पूर्व निर्धारित और अपरिहार्य है) • **Conformist **means a person who follows the norms and customs of society. (एक व्यक्ति जो समाज के मानदंडों और रीति-रिवाजों का पालन करता है) 1a9:Tbe7, The correct answer is: **Ignoble**
